articles.title: Crossing the Divide: Israeli and Palestinian Entrepreneurs Bet on Business to Build Peace
articles.summary: In a war-torn region, a startup accelerator called 50:50 is bringing together Israelis and Palestinians to launch companies. Salah Hussein, once terrified of Israeli soldiers, now co-founded Qanara Tech with Israeli Yana Shaulov. Their AI camera detects greenhouse pests. Despite backlash and a 90% startup failure rate, they believe tiny collaborations can spark change.

articles.title: Shenzhou 23 Launches with First Hong Kong Astronaut and a Yearlong Stay Ahead
articles.summary: China's Shenzhou 23 mission lifted off Sunday carrying three astronauts to the Tiangong space station. Lai Ka-ying, a computer forensics expert, is Hong Kong's first astronaut. One crew member will remain in orbit for a full year to test human limits in long-duration spaceflight—a crucial step for future lunar and Mars missions.

articles.title: Kenton Cool Summits Everest for 20th Time, Breaking His Own Record and Eyeing More
articles.summary: British guide Kenton Cool, 52, scaled Everest for a record 20th time by a non-Sherpa, reaching the summit Friday amid a season of both crowds and danger. A record 274 climbers topped out in one day after a serac delay compressed the weather window. Cool advocates for experience-based permitting, not number caps, as Nepal considers new regulations.
